en: Colorized view of a large central square with market stalls, umbrellas and a prominent statue on a stepped pedestal in the middle. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and shop signs in German at street level. In the background, a steep, tree-covered hill rises above the town, crowned by a fortified structure and a distinctive clock tower. The printed words "Graz" and "Hauptplatz" appear at the top of the image.
